notes.title: Update 11.08.2024
notes.notes: The character's energy consumption is reduced. The comfort of the game has been improved.

notes.title: BugFix
notes.notes:
BugFix:
-Fixed a critical bug that prevented items in air purifiers from being saved.
-Fixed a bug because of which the widget was not deleted after deleting a chest.
-Fixed a bug with collisions of buildings that use electricity.

notes.title: Terra revive release!
notes.notes:
🎉Terra revive release! 🎉
Dear gamers!

We are happy to announce that our new game "TerraRevive" is now available for download! Dive into an exciting world of adventure, exploration and survival.

What's in store for you:
Captivating plot: The story of a land that has been almost completely destroyed.
Graphics: Realistic environment model based on real data from our neighboring planet "Venus".
Gameplay: Intuitive controls and a lot of game mechanics.
Don't miss the chance to be a part of this unforgettable adventure! 
Start your journey right now!


Follow our news on social media and share your experiences with the hashtag #Terrarevive.

Thank you for your support and enjoy the game
